# Belk Digital

> Belk Digital is a full-service digital agency specializing in Next.js web development, WordPress development, SEO, and custom web design for businesses in the United States, Europe, GCC, and Australia.

Belk Digital builds high-performance websites and digital products that are fast, scalable, and optimized for search engines. Our primary expertise includes Next.js development, WordPress development, technical SEO, UI/UX design, SaaS development, and Shopify.

## Core Services

- [Next.js Web Development](https://belkdigital.com/en/services/web-development): Custom React and Next.js web applications for US businesses — fast, scalable, and SEO-optimized.
- [WordPress Development](https://belkdigital.com/en/services/web-development): Custom WordPress websites including theme development, plugin integration, and headless WordPress builds.
- [SEO Services](https://belkdigital.com/en/services/seo-optimization): Technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, and international SEO for businesses targeting the US market.
- [Custom Web Design & UI/UX](https://belkdigital.com/en/services/custom-web-design): Brand-aligned, conversion-focused web design built for performance.
- [Website Redesign](https://belkdigital.com/en/services/website-redesign): Full redesign and optimization of existing websites with SEO-safe migration.
- [Shopify Development](https://belkdigital.com/en/services/shopify-development): Custom Shopify themes and e-commerce solutions for US DTC brands.
- [SaaS Development](https://belkdigital.com/en/services/web-development): Full-stack SaaS platforms using Next.js, Node.js, and React.
- [Website Maintenance & Support](https://belkdigital.com/en/services/maintenance): Ongoing maintenance, security updates, and server management.
